title: Cheap Broadband: Social Tariffs & Low-Cost Plans
description: Social tariffs are cheaper broadband and mobile plans for people on Universal Credit and other benefits: who qualifies and how to apply.
intro: If you get Universal Credit, Pension Credit or certain other benefits, you may be able to get a much cheaper broadband or mobile plan, called a social tariff, from your current provider or a new one.

highlights.title: Who qualifies
highlights.text: Usually people on Universal Credit, Pension Credit and some other means-tested benefits. Each provider sets its own criteria.

highlights.title: No exit fees
highlights.text: Social tariffs are typically short contracts, and moving to one from your provider shouldn’t cost an exit fee. Ask.

highlights.title: How to apply
highlights.text: Contact the provider. They usually check eligibility with the DWP or ask for proof of benefits.

sections.html: Social tariffs are discounted broadband or mobile plans for households on low incomes. In the UK, many providers offer them, and Ofcom keeps an up-to-date list of who offers what. Find it on the Ofcom social tariffs page.

sections.h2: Other ways to cut your bill
sections.html:
• Haggle at the end of your contract: your provider must tell you its best deals when your term ends.
  • Drop the landline if you don’t use it.
  • Go SIM only once your phone is paid off. See SIM only.
  • Pick the speed you need, not the fastest. Use our speed guide.

In the US, the federal Lifeline program offers discounts for eligible households, and many providers run low-income plans. In Europe, several countries have social tariffs or affordability measures. Ask your provider or national regulator.

faqs.a: Not necessarily. Many offer decent speeds suitable for streaming and video calls. Check the speed of the plan offered.

faqs.q: Can I get a social tariff if I’m in contract?
faqs.a: Often yes. Ask your provider. Some will move you to their social tariff without an exit fee.

cardText: Discounted broadband and mobile for people on Universal Credit and other benefits.
